country.name: Mozambique

default_in_force_rule.text: Lei n.º 6/2006 (Boletim da República): os actos normativos entram em vigor no prazo neles fixado ou, na falta de fixação, 15 dias após a publicação. Each law here states its own commencement, which is used as given.

country.licence_note: Texts published by the Assembleia da República (parlamento.mz). No licence is stated on the site; official legislative texts. This repository is private.

sources.name: Assembleia da República: Constituição da República (2004, as approved)
sources.notes: Born-digital PDF (Word), 97 pages, 306 articles: the text approved on 16 November 2004.

sources.name: Assembleia da República, Secretariado-Geral: Legislação Básica (2022)
sources.notes: Born-digital compilation; PDF pages 14-156 hold the Constitution as revised by Lei n.º 1/2018 (313 articles). It prints "Promulgado, a 16 de Novembro de 2014" (sic) under the 2004 approval formula; the formula is not a unit here.

sources.name: Conselho Constitucional: Historial
sources.notes: "Em 2004, uma nova Constituição da República é aprovada tendo entrado em vigor a 21 de Janeiro de 2005". Its PDFs of the 1990, 2004 and 2018 texts and of Lei n.º 26/2007 are image scans (not used: no OCR).

sources.name: WIPO Lex: Constitution of the Republic of Mozambique (details 21389)
sources.notes: Entry into force 21 January 2005; adopted 16 November 2004; Lei n.º 1/2018 "promulgated on June 11, 2018, and was published and entered into force on June 12, 2018".

decisions: Only born-digital PDFs with a text layer are read; scanned Boletim da República issues and scanned PDFs are left out and named (no OCR).

Text normalisation: NBSP and runs of spaces collapsed, curly quotes to straight, en and em dashes to "-", page numbers and running footers dropped, lines joined into paragraphs (blank-line separated in the 2004 PDF; in the 2022 compilation a wrapped line ends in a space and a new item starts with its number or letter).
Units: the preamble and one file per article (art-NNN), the article heading on the first line. Title, chapter and section headings and the closing approval and signature formula are not units.
ai_use: Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) wrote fetch.py and parse.py and chose the sources. No model wrote or altered legal text, and no model runs at build time.
